verdict.rationale: AgentMail offers primitives an agent could use to triage email: Labels to track conversation state, allow/block Lists for filtering, full-text thread search, and real-time webhooks/WebSockets on new mail. There is no evidence of a built-in AI that auto-labels, categorizes or surfaces priority mail, so the user must build the triage agent and its logic. Missing for 10: built-in AI auto-labeling/categorization, attention/priority surfacing, user-steerable triage rules, an audit log of triage decisions, and hands-on corroboration.
